item.title: A child for the Argyreoi: Alkgenes Thrasides ~1609, born to Thrasope #6380 and Glaukdotos
item.description: A child for the Argyreoi: Alkgenes Thrasides ~1609, born to Thrasope #6380 and Glaukdotos #8147. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.title: Lysion #9829 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Iolc
item.description: Lysion #9829 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Iolcus. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Lysion #9829 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus).
item.description: Lysion #9829 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
